Derek is a decorated, 20-year Veteran of the United States Air Force, Certified Flight Instructor, and one of the most enthusiastic pilots you will meet. He has flown corporate contracts for companies like SumoFiber, Fidelity Investments, Meow Wolf, Chick-Fil-A, and maintains a perfect safety record.
